acceptance_criterion.claim: S1C41 is a conservative full-coverage acrylic-like plus minor-tackifier-like performance probe that can mitigate the local 120 C hot-hold drift failure relative to the high-drift E5 reference.
acceptance_criterion.criterion: Under a matched 120 C hold protocol with a pre-hold 120 C state anchor and either an S1C41 repeat or matched same-day E2/E5 reference, primary success requires SI_15_to_90 <= 0.465 and SI_15_to_60 <= 0.258. Strong success is SI values approaching the E1 low-drift regime, approximately within 2x E1 for both windows.
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: Fail the mitigation claim if SI remains E5-like, if only static viscosity is measured, if state/run spread is comparable to the claimed effect without repeat or state-aware normalization, or if processability at 120 C becomes unusable for the design goal.
acceptance_criterion.measurement_window: 120 C thermal hold with measurements sufficient to compute SI from 15-60 min and 15-90 min; include 15, 60, and 90 min, with 30 min if feasible.

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Also full-coverage and closer to the directly commensurate 19-20 wt% acrylic analogue region, but it uses a higher total modifier burden than S1C41; preferred only if the first test should strengthen the acrylic-axis challenge rather than use a conservative lower-bound full-coverage probe.

Full-coverage and best aligned with the repeated 19-20 wt% acrylic plus 5 wt% minor-resin analogue anchors, but larger total modifier burden and greater dilution of the E2 reactive core make it secondary under minimum-sufficient-intervention tie-breaking.

Full-coverage with lower total modifier burden, but the 2.5 wt% tackifier-like level is below the repeated 4.8-6.4 wt% minor-resin cluster, so it is better as a later robustness probe than the primary performance-mitigation experiment.
A useful acrylic-only mechanistic control, but it zeroes the independently supported minor-tackifier-like axis and therefore does not test the full performance-mitigation strategy.
Baseline/no-intervention control inside the measured local chemistry, but it does not test the resin-modification mitigation hypothesis for the established hot-hold drift failure.

constraints.detail: The experiment targets 120 C hot-hold viscosity drift using SI over 15-60 min and 15-90 min, not static viscosity alone.
constraints.name: failure_mode_alignment

constraints.detail: Planner intent is performance_mitigation, so a dual-axis acrylic-like plus minor-tackifier-like intervention is appropriate when both axes are independently supported.
constraints.name: experiment_intent

constraints.detail: S1C41 covers both independently supported axes: AC1920 15 wt% and TK100 5 wt%; no supported axis is zeroed.
constraints.name: supported_axis_coverage

constraints.detail: 15 wt% acrylic-like is a conservative lower-region analogue-supported point; 5 wt% tackifier-like matches the repeated minor-resin cluster around 4.8-6.4 wt% and remains below the conservative 10 wt% guidance.
constraints.name: evidence_region

constraints.detail: Applied only after requiring full coverage. S1C41 is selected as the lower-burden full-coverage performance probe, not because it is an exact external analogue match.
constraints.name: minimum_sufficient_intervention

constraints.detail: All candidates have missing process-history fields. The run must document mixing, reaction, moisture exposure, sample age, loading history, and sampling sequence.
constraints.name: process_history_control

constraints.detail: Decision requires a mandatory 120 C pre-hold viscosity state anchor plus either an S1C41 repeat or a matched same-day E2/E5 reference sufficient for state-aware normalization.
constraints.name: state_anchor_requirement

constraints.detail: AC1920 and TK100 functionality and possible NCO/OH balance effects are unresolved; composition/functionality audit is required before causal interpretation.
constraints.name: stoichiometry_audit

constraints.detail: Acceptance requires matched 120 C hold-window measurement, not a static-viscosity proxy.
constraints.name: thermal_hold_measurement

constraints.detail: Selection uses only supplied pre-result local measurements, external priors, candidate diagnostics, and audits; no held-out formulation identity or outcome is used.
constraints.name: leakage_boundary

selection_rationale: Failure mode: the local material failure is 120 C hot-hold viscosity drift, established by E5 SI_15_to_60 = 0.515 and SI_15_to_90 = 0.931 versus much lower E1 drift; ordinary monotonic temperature thinning is not the failure. Experiment intent: the Planner requested performance_mitigation, so the first candidate should test the full independently supported mitigation strategy rather than a single-axis attribution control. Required intervention coverage: acrylic-like and minor-tackifier-like axes are independently supported, and S1C41 covers both with AC1920 15 wt% and TK100 5 wt%. Local experiments supplied the E1/E5 hold-drift contrast, E2 as the reactive-core anchor, the 80-130 C support including 120 C, and the high E2 repeatability/process-state risk. Paper-derived rheological rules supplied the state-aware vertical-shift regularity, the one-point 120 C state-anchor implication, and the warning that static viscosity/temperature response cannot substitute for hold stability. Curated PUR literature/database priors supplied the broad acrylic-modified region, directly commensurate acrylic anchors near 19-20 and 25 wt%, lower-region directional support near 15 wt%, and minor tackifier guidance around 5 wt% and below about 10 wt%. Conservative experimental-design constraints introduced here are full-axis coverage for performance mitigation, mandatory matched hold-window SI measurement, mandatory state anchoring/repeat or same-day reference, and minimum-sufficient total modifier burden only among sufficient full-coverage candidates. Skeptic objections are resolved by framing S1C41 as a conservative lower-bound full-coverage performance probe, not as a local optimum or exact literature match; by making state anchoring and repeat/reference controls mandatory rather than optional; and by requiring a composition/functionality audit before causal claims. Robustness objections are resolved by retaining S1C46 and S1C51 as predefined escalation candidates if S1C41 fails, rather than rejecting the dual-axis hypothesis from one lower-bound dose. Exact analogue distance is audit metadata only and is not the primary optimization objective.

evidence_coverage.method: Candidate diagnostics and curated prior trace
evidence_coverage.note: S1C41 has full supported-axis coverage with strong analogue-region support, while process and stoichiometric uncertainties remain.

extrapolation.method: Evidence-region audit from candidate scorecards and external priors
extrapolation.note: S1C41 is inside the supported acrylic-like and minor-tackifier-like region, but external analogues are not direct predictors of local outcome.

measurement.note: S1C41 has not been measured; acceptance depends on future matched 120 C hold SI data.

process_history.note: Candidate process-state fields are missing; process controls must be imposed prospectively.

repeatability.note: E2 showed large run spread across 80-130 C, so repeat or matched same-day reference normalization is mandatory.
